additional_hostile_test.source:
"""G17I2 independent additional hostiles against the patched candidate.

These are reviewer-authored, not original G17 or G17I tests. They use the same
public `run`, `receive_handoff` and material/owner canonical paths.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CAND = ROOT / "target_candidate"
sys.path.insert(0, str(CAND / "candidate"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(CAND))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tests"))
from lab_sgi1.history import h_obj
from lab_sgi1.joint import material_joint_opportunity, observe_joint_actions
from lab_sgi1.mother import build_mother_checkpoint
from lab_sgi1.research import inputs, run
from lab_sgi1.relation import reconcile
import c9_handoff_consumer as C9
from test_g17i_independent import history, world, relation_packet


def _nested_packet():
    data = inputs()
    data["joint_material_opportunity"]["metadata"] = {
        "nested": [{"future_child_personality": "DEEP_ALIAS"}]}
    data["joint_material_opportunity"]["event_id"] = h_obj(
        {k: v for k, v in data["joint_material_opportunity"].items()
         if k != "event_id"})
    return data


def test_deep_nested_future_child_alias_refused():
    out = run(_nested_packet())
    assert out["terminal"]["status"] == "FUTURE_CHILD_INFORMATION_LEAK"
    assert out["terminal"]["leaks"][0]["component"] == "joint_material_opportunity"
    assert out["terminal"]["leaks"][0]["field"] == "future_child_personality"


def test_c9_owner_canonical_material_forgery_refused():
    _, _, witness, _ = relation_packet()
    action = deepcopy(witness["actions"][0])
    canonical = deepcopy(witness["material"])
    handoff = C9.build_handoff(action, canonical)
    forged = deepcopy(canonical)
    forged["owner_id"] = "FAKE_CANONICAL_OWNER"
    with pytest.raises(C9.C9Refusal, match="MATERIAL_SOURCE_NOT_AUTHENTIC"):
        C9.receive_handoff(handoff, forged)


def test_c9_canonical_material_still_accepts():
    _, _, witness, _ = relation_packet()
    action = deepcopy(witness["actions"][0])
    canonical = deepcopy(witness["material"])
    handoff = C9.build_handoff(action, canonical)
    receipt = C9.receive_handoff(handoff, canonical)
    assert receipt["status"] == "ACCEPTED"
    assert receipt["e2_later_authority"] == "HOLD_UNISSUED"
